title: Bipartisan 'AI Kill Switch Act' introduced after OpenAI breach
summary: US lawmakers proposed letting federal authorities shut down AI models threatening human life or the economy; a separate bill would require Commerce-overseen security audits.
reason: Bill introduction only; direct reaction to the breach.

title: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5
summary: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5, which it says approaches its Fable 5 model across many domains at lower cost; it soon led several public benchmarks.
reason: New frontier model with notable gains.

title: Nvidia, Microsoft, IBM, Meta sign open letter against open-source AI bans
summary: More than a dozen tech firms urged policymakers not to ban open models after reports the administration weighed restricting Chinese open-source AI; signatories grew to ~50.
reason: Industry lobbying for open weights; words only.
